items.title: Obtain Seattle business license tax certificate and file B&O tax
items.authority: Seattle Department of Finance and Administrative Services
items.description: Seattle requires a business license tax certificate (via the state Business Licensing Service) and a Seattle B&O tax return when taxable revenue exceeds the threshold.

items.title: Hold a Spokane city endorsement on your state business license
items.authority: Washington Department of Revenue, Business Licensing Service
items.description: Doing business in Spokane requires a Washington business license with a Spokane endorsement (under the city code); certain limited activities can request an exemption.
